id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|1: "Cobblestone... A young woman is waiting for you in front of your house.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|2: "Cobblestone... A man seems to be in dire straits atop the Sacred Rock.
"Gondolia... A parent and child near the entrance seem to be begging for help.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|3: "Octagonia... A child at the orphanage seems to be searching for a strong warrior.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|4: "Dundrasil Ruins... Deep underground, your loved ones seem to be waiting.
"Puerto Valor... A great trial seems to await at Jasper's mansion.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|5: "Lonalulu... The village chief near the general store seems to need help.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|6: "Phnom Nonh... A boy near a house seems to be in trouble with monsters.
"Sniflheim Castle... A woman in the throne room seems to seek a strong warrior.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|7: "Snaerfelt... A cursed monster in Mirlean Forest seems to be begging for salvation.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|8: "Sniflheim region... A girl in the hideout by the wind cave seems to sleep on.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|9: "Arboria... An old man in the cathedral seems to have something to give you.
"Angri-La... The monks and their leader in the training ground seem to be waiting for you.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|a: "Heliodor Castle... The king in the throne room seems to be waiting for someone.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|b: "Mount Huji... A woman in the land where the fire dragon sleeps seems to need saving.
"Champs Sauvages Castle Ruins... A legendary ember seems to await you deep underground.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|c: "Mount Huji... A special place seems to have been prepared for you deep within.
id./ui/common_2d.pack|seren_hint_msg.bxon|d: "Thanks to your deeds, this world has been saved. On behalf of all living things, allow me to say... thank you.
